constraints: Session Core (Model Plane) owns threads and messages, so the cursor and summaries belong there and flow through model-gateway to the Rust gateway; the Frontend Plane cannot compute them. Cursors must carry no authority: every page re-runs the Control shared read decision and the audience-revision ceiling already applied in list_threads, and summary participants must be filtered per reader so a reply count cannot leak a thread the reader may not see. Keyset order needs a persisted sort key: the current order is computed at read time from the last message, so a (pinned, last_activity_at, id) cursor needs a stored last_activity_at (or message sequence) column plus an index, not a derived expression. ZDR threads are persistence-free and never appear in the listing.
approachAdjustment: Ship the client-only slice first (S): fix the first-30 truncation by paging the transcript from the newest turn backwards, add jump-to-latest and pinned-to-bottom anchoring on poll using the chat precedent and a pure tested policy module, keep aria-setsize/posinset, and try content-visibility/IntersectionObserver per the UI audit before adding a virtual-list dependency (verify solid-virtual on Solid 2 RC only if needed). Then the server slice (M): migration adding a persisted last_activity_at and turn_count/last_turn_at/participant ids maintained at append time, a before/limit+1 has_more query in Session Core, a gateway route with before/limit, and lazy transcript fetch per visible post. Treat 'reply summaries' as per-thread turn summaries, since replies are turns in the post, and drop the dependency on F-t1-003 server seq unless it ships first.
effortNote: Raised from M: the change spans a Session Core migration and query, model-gateway, the Rust gateway, the SPA windowing and an anchoring module with tests. The client-only slice stays S and is the real quick win.
verdictReason: The gap is real and absent in code, but the item mis-describes the N+1 (polls refetch only changed posts), misses that posts beyond 80 and turns beyond 30 are silently invisible, and its keyset cursor ignores that the sort key is derived at read time, so the approach needs a persisted activity column and a split into client and server slices.
